citation: Kipf & Welling, Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks, ICLR 2017 (arXiv 1609.02907)
task: Semi-supervised node classification
method: Layer-wise propagation H' = sigma(D~^-1/2 A~ D~^-1/2 H W), A~=A+I; first-order approximation of spectral graph convolutions; two-layer model
dataset_protocol: Citeseer/Cora/Pubmed/NELL, Planetoid splits (20 labels per class, 500 val, 1000 test); Adam lr 0.01, <=200 epochs, early stop window 10; Cora 2,708 nodes / 5,429 edges / 1,433 features / 7 classes
relevant_limitation: Fixed degree-based neighbour weights, no learned edge importance; assumes locality and equal importance of self-loops and neighbours; undirected only, no edge features (Sec. 7.2)
design_implication: Use as the non-attention baseline encoder; its fixed weights are why attention can carry extra information beyond degree
verified_by: arXiv abs page + full text (Secs 2, 5, 7.2, Table 1)

citation: Velickovic et al., Graph Attention Networks, ICLR 2018 (arXiv 1710.10903)
task: Node classification (transductive and inductive)
method: Masked self-attention over N_i (incl. self); e_ij=LeakyReLU(a^T[Wh_i||Wh_j]) slope 0.2; softmax over j in N_i; K heads concatenated (hidden) / averaged (output)
dataset_protocol: Cora/Citeseer/Pubmed (Planetoid split) and PPI; transductive 2 layers, 8 heads x 8 features, dropout 0.6 on inputs and attention coefficients, Adam 0.005 (0.01 Pubmed); Cora 83.0+-0.7% vs GCN 81.5%
relevant_limitation: Authors only suggest attention analysis 'may' help interpretability; sparse implementation limits batching; receptive field bounded by depth; sum of coefficients per target is 1
design_implication: Backbone encoder. Never sum alpha over a target's own neighbourhood (constant); aggregate over targets attending to a source instead
verified_by: arXiv abs page + full text (Secs 2.1, 2.2, 3, Tables 1-2)

citation: Brody, Alon, Yahav, How Attentive are Graph Attention Networks?, ICLR 2022 (arXiv 2105.14491)
task: Expressiveness of graph attention; node/link/graph prediction
method: Defines static vs dynamic attention; GAT is static (Thm 1); GATv2 e=a^T LeakyReLU(W[h_i||h_j]) is dynamic (Thm 2)
dataset_protocol: DictionaryLookup synthetic task; OGB node (arxiv, products, mag, proteins), link and QM9 benchmarks; random edge-noise robustness on ogbn-arxiv/mag; 12 benchmarks
relevant_limitation: Gains are dataset-dependent; a non-attentive model wins in a few benchmarks; dynamic attention mostly helps in high-degree graphs
design_implication: Optional GATv2 switch is justified; under GAT, received attention partly reflects a node-global key score, so compare against degree-matched nulls
verified_by: arXiv abs page + full text (Secs 2.2, 3, 4.2, 4.3, Table 1)

citation: Ding, Li, Bhanushali, Liu, Deep Anomaly Detection on Attributed Networks, SDM 2019, pp. 594-602, doi 10.1137/1.9781611975673.67
task: Unsupervised node anomaly detection on attributed networks
method: Shared GCN encoder, GCN attribute decoder, GCN+inner-product structure decoder; score = alpha*||x-x_hat||+(1-alpha)*||a-a_hat|| (alpha default 0.8 in official PyTorch code)
dataset_protocol: BlogCatalog/Flickr/ACM with injected structural (cliques) and contextual (farthest-of-k attribute swap) anomalies; ROC-AUC. Paper-specific parameters NOT verified (paper unreachable); secondary papers report clique size 15, 10/15/20 cliques, k=50
relevant_limitation: Injected anomalies are easy relative to organic ones (BOND); official repo evaluates AUC every 10 epochs on test labels and ships no injection script; dense N x N structure decoder
design_implication: Implements reconstruction scoring and is the template for our DOMINANT-style rule; state alpha convention; do not quote paper-specific injection numbers
verified_by: ASU Pure record; GitHub READMEs; PyTorch model.py, run.py, utils.py; paper PDF NOT opened

citation: Ying, Bourgeois, You, Zitnik, Leskovec, GNNExplainer, NeurIPS 2019 (arXiv 1903.03894)
task: Post-hoc explanation of GNN predictions
method: Learns soft edge mask (sigmoid) and feature mask maximising mutual information with the prediction; size and entropy regularisers
dataset_protocol: Synthetic BA-Shapes/BA-Community/Tree-Cycles/Tree-Grid with ground-truth motifs (explanation accuracy as edge classification); Mutag, Reddit-Binary; baselines Grad and ATT (GAT attention)
relevant_limitation: States GAT attention is the same across all node predictions, so cannot give instance-specific explanations; ATT baseline weak; accuracy needs ground-truth motifs
design_implication: Do not equate attention with explanation; our deletion test is a separate sanity check, optionally compared with a GNNExplainer mask
verified_by: NeurIPS proceedings page + arXiv full text (Secs 2, 4, 5, Table 1)

citation: Gutierrez-Gomez, Bovet, Delvenne, Multi-scale Anomaly Detection on Attributed Networks, AAAI 2020, 34(1):678-685
task: Unsupervised anomaly detection and context discovery on attributed networks
method: Gaussian attribute-similarity edge weights; heat-kernel (graph wavelet) smoothing across scales; Markov-stability style context; Chebyshev approximation for scale
dataset_protocol: Synthetic planted-partition networks with injected anomalies; Disney (124 nodes), Books (1,418), Enron (13,533); ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision/recall/F1
relevant_limitation: Restricted to undirected, connected, simple graphs; real datasets small with few labelled anomalies; not a neural method
